subpages.text: Skip to content Home Who We Are Partner Store Partner Portal IPTECHVIEW 972.831.1600 Search ABP Technology and the Partner Store IP Technology & AI Integration Menu ☰ Company Who We Are What We Do Who We Serve Solutions Phones & UC Video Surveillance & AI Supervision Wired Infrastructure Wireless Infrastructure Preconfigured Fulfillment Request a Quote AI Integrator AI Voice AI Video Partner Journey Resources Vendors Events & Training Press & Company News Vendor News Guides & Downloads Newsletter Support Blog Contact Us Become a Partner Founded 2001 Who We Are ABP Technology is a value-add specialty distributor for IP technology solutions. We give our technology partners the products, tools, and support to earn a competitive edge — and, increasingly, a path to AI-powered services. A bet on IP, before IP was the safe choice ABP Technology was founded in 2001, when IP was fresh and SIP was an emerging technology. At the time, many experts thought IP technology lacked the power and reliability to replace proven analog systems. Only the daring would leave that behind. Our founder and his team built ABP around the potential he saw in pervasive IP technology and VoIP, combined with a distribution model based on a narrow portfolio of leading products, a dedicated distribution center, and value-added services to deploy emerging technology safely and profitably. ABP grew to support open-standard solutions across wired and wireless IP infrastructure, IP video surveillance and physical security, and IP communications, voice and video. Now we are betting again — on a rapid and unstoppable integration of AI into IP technology, and again on intrepid technology partners to help their customers stay on top of things.
